questions.question: A client reads the current inventory count without requesting a state change. Which method expresses that intent?
questions.explanation: GET requests a representation with read-only semantics.

questions.question: In https://shop.example/orders?page=2, which part is the path?
questions.explanation: The path identifies the resource location before the query string.

questions.question: A request has a JSON body. Which header describes the format of that body?
questions.explanation: Content-Type describes the message body. Accept describes preferred response media types.
